localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of approximately 5-8 discrete, roughly circular low-intensity pixel clusters (dark spots) localized within the high-intensity (light grey) medial patch of the visible appendage.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of 4-5 non-continuous, low-intensity vertical linear pixel disruptions that break the consistency of the high-intensity pigmentation mapping on the central surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The high-intensity region exhibits several dark, irregular markings including vertical streaks and small circular voids that appear distinct from the primary pigmentation gradient.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible high-contrast bimodal intensity distribution on an elongated appendage, featuring a dominant high-intensity central region and a superior boundary characterized by periodic pixel-amplitude variations (tubercles).
